sections.heading: Jay Z — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Jay Z was born on 4 December 1969 in Brooklyn, and holds American nationality. He was given the name Shawn Corey Carter at birth and is publicly known as Jay Z.
Public records name his father, Adnes Reeves and his mother, Gloria Carter.
He studied at George Westinghouse Career and Technical Education High School and Trenton Central High School.
He is recorded as speaking English.

sections.heading: Jay Z — Career and Professional Work
paras: Jay Z works primarily as a rapper, songwriter, record producer, music executive, businessperson and media proprietor, with Louis Vuitton listed among his employers.
